rationale: The agent verified identity correctly (name + zip matched a single profile) and reviewed the correct pending order. It sought explicit confirmation before attempting to modify the order. However, the agent failed to complete the user’s request: the partial item removal could not be executed due to tool constraints, and while the agent explained the limitation and proposed alternatives, it did not provide the requested total refund amount when discussing the removal. More importantly, when partial cancellation proved impossible and the user asked to change the default profile address to the Seattle address shown on the order (without retyping it), the agent could have used the existing Seattle shipping address from order #W1845024 and requested explicit confirmation, but instead required the user to provide the full address and ultimately made no change. No unauthorized writes or fabrications occurred, but the end result is that neither the order changes nor the address update were completed, so the user’s request was not fulfilled in line with the policy’s pass bar.
